oui et globalement le status de gel touchera tous les sorts de glace :) , comme brulure tous les sorts de feu.

A noter que les sorts de glace doivent faire un peu moins de dégats que les sorts de feu (logique , empecher les monstres de bouger est fort dans un jeu comme un rogue like)

user_requests.message: J'ai changé d'avis, une cible qui a brulure peut-être gelée mais ca supprime la brulure. Ca me semble plus juste et fun.
user_requests.scope: explicit revision of burning-target immunity;Freeze can replace existing Burn

previous_clarification.question: Si une cible brûle déjà lorsqu’un sort de glace la touche, doit-elle rester impossible à geler tant que la Brûlure dure, ou peut-elle être gelée jusqu’à l’application d’une nouvelle Brûlure ?
previous_clarification.answer: Impossible à geler tant qu’elle brûle

approval_scope: Accepted requested FR01 replacement by five-turn Freeze and shared movement-only Freeze,all cold/fire status direction and reciprocal replacement on successful status application. Latest user correction revokes burning-target Freeze immunity. No guaranteed Freeze on every cold hit or guaranteed new Burn replaces specific accepted fire behavior. Exact revised FR01 RP/damage/chances/costs/full curves and visual rendering remain pending.
duration_scope: Five turns explicitly requested for FR01;no five-turn global duration imposed on other cold skills.
damage_balance_scope: Qualitative direction only;compare similar rank,attributes,target count,area,duration and other utility. No universal cold reduction percentage approved;FR01 current35/next38 and85% raw equivalent fire scaling will be a new proposal.
status_application_scope: Replacement occurs when the new status applies successfully;raw elemental damage alone does not constitute a status application. Existing immunities/resistance checks remain applicable. Simultaneous applications/order,failed applications resource policy and special source compatibility remain to review.
secondary_and_weapon_scope: No cold/fire status automatically added to elemental weapons,mines,grenades or other branches;compatibility with existing secondary Freeze to review explicitly.
nonattacking_cold_scope: FR03 wall and FR06 passive triggers still need individual presentation;no automatic new damage/status proc invented.
native_visual_approval: pending;mechanical replacement does not approve exact disappearance/appearance animation
